headline: Marriott International Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: Marriott International, Inc. (Nasdaq: MAR) today announced that its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of 73 cents per share of common stock. The dividend is payable on September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 20, 2026.
